<p dir="auto">Automatically discovers and indexes new LLM evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and harnesses as they appear on GitHub. Generates a structured, searchable catalog with metadata like stars, activity, and category tags. Designed for ML engineers who need to stay current without manually scanning repositories.</p>
<p dir="auto">This list is <strong>auto-updated every 15 minutes</strong> by a GitHub Actions cron.
Each commit reflects a real change in the upstream data source — new items added,
expired items removed — so you can rely on what you see being current.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🔍 How it works</h2><a id="user-content--how-it-works" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🔍 How it works" href="#-how-it-works"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Every 15 minutes, a GitHub Action runs <code>tracker.py</code>. That script:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Fetches the latest state from <code>GitHub Search API</code>.</li>
<li>Diffs against <code>data/items.json</code> (the previous snapshot).</li>
<li>Rewrites the table above between the <code>&lt;!-- TRACKER_TABLE_* --&gt;</code> markers.</li>
<li>Commits <code>feat: +N added, -M removed (timestamp)</code> if anything changed.</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">No external services. No paid APIs. Just a public data source and a free GitHub Action.</p>
<hr>

<p dir="auto">A live tracker that queries GitHub Search API for recently created and updated AI coding-agent skill repositories, ranks them by freshness and momentum rather than all-time stars, and publishes a self-updating README leaderboard via GitHub Actions.</p>
<p dir="auto">This list is <strong>auto-updated every 15 minutes</strong> by a GitHub Actions cron.
Each commit reflects a real change in the upstream data source — new items added,
expired items removed — so you can rely on what you see being current.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🔍 How it works</h2><a id="user-content--how-it-works" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🔍 How it works" href="#-how-it-works"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Every 15 minutes, a GitHub Action runs <code>tracker.py</code>. That script:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Fetches the latest state from <code>GitHub Search API</code>.</li>
<li>Diffs against <code>data/items.json</code> (the previous snapshot).</li>
<li>Rewrites the table above between the <code>&lt;!-- TRACKER_TABLE_* --&gt;</code> markers.</li>
<li>Commits <code>feat: +N added, -M removed (timestamp)</code> if anything changed.</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">No external services. No paid APIs. Just a public data source and a free GitHub Action.</p>
<hr>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">🤝 Contributing</h2><a id="user-content--contributing" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🤝 Contributing" href="#-contributing"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">See <code>CONTRIBUTING.md</code> — usually you don't need to: the tracker keeps itself current.
If you spot a data-source bug or want to suggest a new column for the table, open
an issue.</p>

a unified platform of pre-trained AI/ML models for 🦠 infectious and neglected disease research. Our mission is to offer an open-source, 🛠 low-code solution that provides seamless access to AI/ML models for 💊 drug discovery. Models housed in our hub come from two sources:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003ePublished models from literature (with due third-party acknowledgement)\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eCustom models developed by the Ersilia team or our valued contributors\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eIn Ersilia, you can find models related to antibiotic activity prediction, ADMET prediction, molecular representation, generative chemistry, and much more.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eTo find your models of interest, visit the \u003ca href=\"https://catalog.ersilia.io/\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003eErsilia Model Hub browser\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eFor high-level the package requirements in the \u003ca href=\"https://ersilia.gitbook.io/ersilia-book/ersilia-model-hub/local-inference\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003eInstallation Guide\u003c/a\u003e. In brief:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003col dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eYou need to install the Ersilia CLI. This is the central tool to manage models in the Ersilia Model Hub.\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003eEach model is packaged independently in its own environment\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ol\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eTo \u003cstrong\u003einstall the Ersilia CLI\u003c/strong\u003e, create a \u003ca href=\"https://docs.conda.io/projects/conda/en/latest/user-guide/getting-started.html\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003eConda\u003c/a\u003e environment and activate it:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"conda create -n ersilia python=3.10\nconda activate ersilia\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003econda create -n ersilia python=3.10\nconda activate ersilia\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThen, clone the current repository and install with \u003ccode\u003epip\u003c/code\u003e:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"git clone https://github.com/ersilia-os/ersilia.git\ncd ersilia\npip install -e .\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003egit clone https://github.com/ersilia-os/ersilia.git\n\u003cspan class=\"pl-c1\"\u003ecd\u003c/span\u003e ersilia\npip install -e \u003cspan class=\"pl-c1\"\u003e.\u003c/span\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eAlternatively, you can directly install \u003ca href=\"https://pypi.org/project/ersilia/\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003efrom PyPi\u003c/a\u003e:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"pip install ersilia\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003epip install ersilia\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eCheck that Ersilia is properly installed:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"ersilia --help\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003eersilia --help\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eTo \u003cstrong\u003einstall each model\u003c/strong\u003e, you have two options. You can either package them from source, in which case only Conda is required, or as \u003ca href=\"https://www.docker.com/\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003eDocker containers\u003c/a\u003e. We highly recommend having Docker installed and active in your computer. In any case, the Ersilia CLI takes care of the packaging seamlessly.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch3 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eRunning a Model\u003c/h3\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-running-a-model\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: Running a Model\" href=\"#running-a-model\"\u003e\u003csvg data-component=\"Octicon\" class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eOnce the Ersilia package is installed, you can use the CLI to run any model seamlessly. First, select a model from the \u003ca href=\"https://ersilia.io/model-hub/\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003eErsilia Model Hub\u003c/a\u003e and fetch it. Each model in the Ersilia Model Hub has an associated identifier. For example, the broad spectrum activity prediction model from \u003ca href=\"/ersilia-os/ersilia/blob/master\"\u003e\u003cem\u003eStokes\u003c/em\u003e et al. (2020)\u003c/a\u003e has the identifier \u003ccode\u003eeos4e40\u003c/code\u003e. You can \u003cstrong\u003efetch\u003c/strong\u003e it as follows:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"ersilia fetch eos4e40\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003eersilia fetch eos4e40\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eNow you can \u003cstrong\u003eserve\u003c/strong\u003e the model:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"ersilia serve eos4e40\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003eersilia serve eos4e40\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eTo view some \u003cstrong\u003einformation\u003c/strong\u003e about the model, type the following:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"ersilia info\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003eersilia info\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThe simplest way to run a model is by passing a CSV file as input. If you don't have one, you can generate it easily. In this case, we take 5 molecules as an \u003cstrong\u003eexample\u003c/strong\u003e:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"ersilia example -n 5 -f my_input.csv\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003eersilia example -n 5 -f my_input.csv\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eNow you can \u003cstrong\u003erun\u003c/strong\u003e the model:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"ersilia run -i my_input.csv -o my_output.csv\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003eersilia run -i my_input.csv -o my_output.csv\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eTo stop the service, you can simply \u003cstrong\u003eclose\u003c/strong\u003e the model:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"ersilia close\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003eersilia close\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eFinally, if you don't want to use the model anymore, \u003cstrong\u003edelete\u003c/strong\u003e it as follows:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto\" dir=\"auto\" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=\"ersilia delete eos4e40\"\u003e\u003cpre\u003eersilia delete eos4e40\u003c/pre\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch3 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Project Description</h2><a id="user-content-project-description" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Project Description" href="#project-description"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The <a href="https://ersilia.io" rel="nofollow">Ersilia Model Hub</a> is a unified platform of pre-trained AI/ML models for 🦠 infectious and neglected disease research. Our mission is to offer an open-source, 🛠 low-code solution that provides seamless access to AI/ML models for 💊 drug discovery. Models housed in our hub come from two sources:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Published models from literature (with due third-party acknowledgement)</li>
<li>Custom models developed by the Ersilia team or our valued contributors</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">In Ersilia, you can find models related to antibiotic activity prediction, ADMET prediction, molecular representation, generative chemistry, and much more.</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>To find your models of interest, visit the <a href="https://catalog.ersilia.io/" rel="nofollow">Ersilia Model Hub browser</a></li>
<li>For high-level documentation, check the <a href="https://ersilia.gitbook.io/ersilia-book/" rel="nofollow">Ersilia Book</a></li>
<li>For a low-level documentation for developers, see the <a href="https://ersilia-os.github.io/ersilia/" rel="nofollow">Ersilia API reference</a></li>
<li>To contribute with new models, visit the <a href="https://contribute.ersilia.io" rel="nofollow">Contribute App</a></li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Quick Start Guide</h2><a id="user-content-quick-start-guide" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Quick Start Guide" href="#quick-start-guide"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Installation</h3><a id="user-content-installation" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Installation" href="#installation"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Please check the package requirements in the <a href="https://ersilia.gitbook.io/ersilia-book/ersilia-model-hub/local-inference" rel="nofollow">Installation Guide</a>. In brief:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>You need to install the Ersilia CLI. This is the central tool to manage models in the Ersilia Model Hub.</li>
<li>Each model is packaged independently in its own environment</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">To <strong>install the Ersilia CLI</strong>, create a <a href="https://docs.conda.io/projects/conda/en/latest/user-guide/getting-started.html" rel="nofollow">Conda</a> environment and activate it:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="conda create -n ersilia python=3.10
conda activate ersilia"><pre>conda create -n ersilia python=3.10
conda activate ersilia</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Then, clone the current repository and install with <code>pip</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="git clone https://github.com/ersilia-os/ersilia.git
cd ersilia
pip install -e ."><pre>git clone https://github.com/ersilia-os/ersilia.git
<span class="pl-c1">cd</span> ersilia
pip install -e <span class="pl-c1">.</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Alternatively, you can directly install <a href="https://pypi.org/project/ersilia/" rel="nofollow">from PyPi</a>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="pip install ersilia"><pre>pip install ersilia</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Check that Ersilia is properly installed:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="ersilia --help"><pre>ersilia --help</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">To <strong>install each model</strong>, you have two options. You can either package them from source, in which case only Conda is required, or as <a href="https://www.docker.com/" rel="nofollow">Docker containers</a>. We highly recommend having Docker installed and active in your computer. In any case, the Ersilia CLI takes care of the packaging seamlessly.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Running a Model</h3><a id="user-content-running-a-model" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Running a Model" href="#running-a-model"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Once the Ersilia package is installed, you can use the CLI to run any model seamlessly. First, select a model from the <a href="https://ersilia.io/model-hub/" rel="nofollow">Ersilia Model Hub</a> and fetch it. Each model in the Ersilia Model Hub has an associated identifier. For example, the broad spectrum activity prediction model from <a href="/ersilia-os/ersilia/blob/master"><em>Stokes</em> et al. (2020)</a> has the identifier <code>eos4e40</code>. You can <strong>fetch</strong> it as follows:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="ersilia fetch eos4e40"><pre>ersilia fetch eos4e40</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Now you can <strong>serve</strong> the model:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="ersilia serve eos4e40"><pre>ersilia serve eos4e40</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">To view some <strong>information</strong> about the model, type the following:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="ersilia info"><pre>ersilia info</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">The simplest way to run a model is by passing a CSV file as input. If you don't have one, you can generate it easily. In this case, we take 5 molecules as an <strong>example</strong>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="ersilia example -n 5 -f my_input.csv"><pre>ersilia example -n 5 -f my_input.csv</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Now you can <strong>run</strong> the model:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="ersilia run -i my_input.csv -o my_output.csv"><pre>ersilia run -i my_input.csv -o my_output.csv</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">To stop the service, you can simply <strong>close</strong> the model:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="ersilia close"><pre>ersilia close</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Finally, if you don't want to use the model anymore, <strong>delete</strong> it as follows:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="ersilia delete eos4e40"><pre>ersilia delete eos4e40</pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Basic Commands</h3><a id="user-content-basic-commands" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Basic Commands" href="#basic-commands"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Below is a list of the most important commands of the Ersilia CLI:</p>
<markdown-accessiblity-table><table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>Command</th>
<th>Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>catalog</code></td>
<td>List a catalog of models</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>close</code></td>
<td>Close model</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>delete</code></td>
<td>Delete model from local computer</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>example</code></td>
<td>Generate input examples for the model of interest</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>fetch</code></td>
<td>Fetch model from the Ersilia Model Hub</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>info</code></td>
<td>Get model information</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>run</code></td>
<td>Run a served model</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>serve</code></td>
<td>Serve model</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>test</code></td>
<td>Test a model</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></markdown-accessiblity-table>
<p dir="auto">Please see the a full reference of all commands available <a href="https://ersilia.gitbook.io/ersilia-book/ersilia-model-hub/developer-docs/command-line-interface" rel="nofollow">here</a>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Contribute</h2><a id="user-content-contribute" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Contribute" href="#contribute"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The Ersilia Model Hub is a free, open source software and we highly value new contributors. There are several ways in which you can contribute to the project:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>A good place to start is checking open <a href="https://github.com/ersilia-os/ersilia/issues">GitHub Issues</a></li>
<li>If you have identified a bug in the code, please open a new issue using the <a href="https://github.com/ersilia-os/ersilia/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml">Bug Report template</a></li>
<li>Share any feedback with the community using <a href="https://github.com/ersilia-os/ersilia/discussions">GitHub Discussions</a> for the project</li>
<li>If you wish to contribute to our main codebase, please make sure to follow our <a href="https://ersilia.gitbook.io/ersilia-book/ersilia-model-hub/developer-docs/developer-guide-for-codebase-quality-and-consistency" rel="nofollow">guidelines for codebase quality and consistency</a></li>
<li>Check our <a href="https://github.com/ersilia-os/ersilia/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md">Contributing Guide</a> for more details</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">The Ersilia Open Source Initiative adheres to the <a href="https://ersilia.gitbook.io/ersilia-wiki/code-of-conduct" rel="nofollow">Contributor Covenant</a> code of conduct.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Submit a New Model</h3><a id="user-content-submit-a-new-model" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Submit a New Model" href="#submit-a-new-model"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">If you want to incorporate a new model in the platform, open a new issue using the <a href="https://github.com/ersilia-os/ersilia/issues/new?assignees=&amp;labels=new-model&amp;template=model_request.yml&amp;title=%F0%9F%A6%A0+Model+Request%3A+%3Cname%3E">Model Request template</a> or contact us using <a href="https://www.ersilia.io/request-model" rel="nofollow">this form</a>.</p>
<p dir="auto">After submitting your model request via an issue (suggested), an Ersilia maintainer will review your request. If they approve your request, a new model respository will be created for you to fork and use following the <a href="https://github.com/ersilia-os/eos-template">eos-template</a>. There is a <a href="https://github.com/ersilia-os/eos-demo">demo repository</a> explaining the steps one-by-one.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Cited By</h3><a id="user-content-cited-by" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Cited By" href="#cited-by"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The Ersilia Model Hub is used in a number of scientific projects. Read more about how we are implementing it in:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><a href="https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-023-41512-2" rel="nofollow">Turon, Hlozek, et al. <em>Nature Communications</em>, 2023</a></li>
<li><a href="https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acsomega.3c05664" rel="nofollow">Van Heerden, et al. <em>ACS Omega</em>, 2023</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.adk5864" rel="nofollow">Offensperger, Tin, Duran-Frigola, et al. <em>Science</em>, 2024</a></li>
<li><a href="https://doi.org/10.1021/acsmedchemlett.4c00131" rel="nofollow">Turon, et al. <em>ACS Med Chem Lett</em>, 2024</a></li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">In addition, our views on how the Ersilia Model Hub can be deployed effectively in Africa can be found in these two articles:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><a href="https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2667318524000254?via%3Dihub" rel="nofollow">Turon and Duran-Frigola, <em>Artificial Intelligence in the Life Sciences</em>, 2024</a></li>
<li><a href="https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acsinfecdis.4c00585" rel="nofollow">Turon and Duran-Frigola, <em>ACS Infectious Disease Research</em>, 2024</a></li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">To see a full list of all Ersilia publications, please visit <a href="https://www.ersilia.io/publications" rel="nofollow">this link</a>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">About Us</h2><a id="user-content-about-us" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: About Us" href="#about-us"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The <a href="https://ersilia.io" rel="nofollow">Ersilia Open Source Initiative</a> is a tech non-profit organization with the mission to equip laboratories, universities, and clinics in the Global South with AI/ML tools for infectious disease research. We work on the principles of open science, decolonized research, and egalitarian access to knowledge and research outputs. You can support Ersilia by clicking <a href="https://www.ersilia.io/donate" rel="nofollow">here</a>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Funding</h3><a id="user-content-funding" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Funding" href="#funding"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The Ersilia Model Hub is our flagship project. The tool is funded via a combination of sources. Full disclosure can be found in our <a href="https://ersilia.io/supporters" rel="nofollow">website</a>. Highlighted supporters include the <a href="https://builders.mozilla.org/" rel="nofollow">Mozilla Builders Accelerator</a>, <a href="https://www.ffwd.org/" rel="nofollow">Fast Forward</a>, <a href="https://www.splunk.com/en_us/about-us/splunk-pledge/nonprofit-license-application.html" rel="nofollow">Splunk Pledge</a>, the <a href="https://ai2050.schmidtsciences.org/" rel="nofollow">AI2050 Program by Schmidt Sciences</a>, and the <a href="https://www.aei.gob.es/convocatorias/buscador-convocatorias/proyectos-generacion-conocimiento-2023" rel="nofollow">Spanish Ministry of Science, Innovation, and Universities</a> (Project PID2023-148309OA-I00 funded by MICIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033 and by ERDF, EU).</p>
